resources.string: Messages only when screen is off
At least one glyph has to stay selected. Turn the rule off to keep the glyphs dark.
Chats with a rule of their own ignore this one.
This rule replaces the event rules for messages and calls from this chat, on all accounts.

Lights up the glyphs on the back of your Nothing phone. Pick which glyphs flash for new messages and which glow for incoming calls and voice recording, and give single chats a rule of their own. Muted chats never trigger a flash. Phone (3) and Phone (4a) Pro show the mauve logo on the Glyph Matrix instead, with no glyphs to pick.
